channel.title: Japan Small-Cap Filings in English

item.title: robot home, Inc.: robot home, Inc. reports change in major shareholder on 2026-11-18.
item.description: Investors capital partners Co., Ltd. becomes a major shareholder, holding 399,500 voting rights (44.95%) after the change. | Furuki Taisaki ceases to be a major shareholder; holding was 399,500 voting rights (44.95%) before the change and none after. | Date of change: 2026-11-18. | Total issued shares as of 2026-06-30: 91,127,000 common shares; 2,270,000 shares excluded as non-voting. | Voting rights percentages are based on the shareholder register as of 2026-06-30.
